354:t_002:9.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Damn...! Have we walked into an enemy trap...?!」

354:t_002:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...You've surprised me, $c. I meant to intercept you on your return from Mars, but you showed up here.」

354:t_002:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But since you've come, all the better! I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, will crush you before Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

354:t_002:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems they didn't know we were coming.」

354:t_002:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this was just a staging base, and $$ストラウス$$ intended to strike us elsewhere.」

354:t_002:15.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That woman, $$クィーン$$... So she really was on our side...」

354:t_002:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「I can't say for sure yet, but the information about the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ seems to have been offered in good faith.」

354:t_002:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「What will you do, Miss $$スメラギ$$?」

354:t_002:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「With no other Reactors here, this is our chance. We'll defeat Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ and retake the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

354:t_002:19.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're facing a fleet. Focus on enemy ships to disrupt their chain of command.」

354:t_002:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If we charge in carelessly, their units' precise attacks, directed by the battleships, will overwhelm us...!」

354:t_002:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come, $$ストラウス$$! I'll be your opponent!」

354:t_003:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's no point dragging this out...! Let's do it, $n!」

354:t_003:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「...$n. It's only natural you can't process what happened with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. But forget it for now.」

354:t_003:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive... That's enough for now.」

354:t_003:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whatever he's thinking, whoever he is, what's wrong with that?」

354:t_003:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've made up your mind, let's go!」

354:t_003:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ストラウス$$! It looks like you know this is the moment of truth, too!」

354:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right, $$ストラウス$$! If you weren't my enemy, maybe we could've shared a good drink!」

354:t_004:2.en:
$$桂$$
「That $$ランド$$! Is he taking $$ストラウス$$ on one-on-one?!」

354:t_004:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's $$ザ・ヒート$$ for you! He's on fire!」

354:t_004:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「W-wait, is this okay?! Will he be all right?!」

354:t_004:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't butt into a showdown between men! We just have to see it through!」

354:t_004:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stay out of it, $$セツコ$$!」

354:t_004:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But their power as a Reactor exceeds $$ランド$$'s! Even with $n there...!」

354:t_004:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...$$ランド$$ and $$ストラウス$$... This feeling... I remember it...」

354:t_004:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is... just like back then... with $$インサラウム$$...」

354:t_004:13.en:
$n
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... I'll let go of both my doubts and my expectations...)

354:t_004:14.en:
$n
(I'll accept the fact that you're alive for what it is...!)

354:t_004:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's settle this, $$ストラウス$$!」

354:t_005:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'm detecting rapid distortion of the dimensional boundary!」

354:t_005:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Is a $$時空震動$$ happening at a time like this?!」

354:t_005:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's what happened when we rescued $$エスター$$ in $$インサラウム$$!」

354:t_005:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This power's even stronger than when it was me and $$ユーサー$$!」

354:t_005:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the hell...?! I can see something!」

354:t_007:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood, Supreme Commander! I'll destroy those artificial humans!」

354:t_009:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s targets are $$シンジ$$ and the others!」

354:t_009:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「But there are types of EVA we've never seen, too!」

354:t_009:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Unit-01 and Unit-02 also differ in their details, but...」

354:t_009:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Since he knows $n, I accept that the pilot is the $$碇シンジ$$ we know! All units, support the four EVAs!」

354:t_009:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...How did we end up in space when we were fighting at the bottom of $$セントラルドグマ$$...?!」

354:t_009:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「It seems letting them pull out that spear was a mistake after all, even if it was just one.」

354:t_009:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「Basically, we were expelled because we could destroy the world... I think this is just like $$サードインパクト$$.」

354:t_009:7.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Brat $$シンジ$$...! You've meddled again...!」

354:t_009:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「So what will you do now, Princess? Those look like $$サイデリアル$$...」

354:t_009:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「It looks like not much time has passed in this world since we were sent away.」

354:t_009:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「But to be transferred somewhere with familiar faces...」

354:t_009:11.en:
$$マリ$$
「We're lucky. ...So lucky I wouldn't just write it off as coincidence.」

354:t_009:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Can you hear me, $c? This is $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$.」

354:t_009:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$アスカ$$...! It really is you, $$アスカ$$!」

354:t_009:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「You've recovered! I'm so glad...! I'm really so glad!」
